proposed_widenings.name: transform_form family
proposed_widenings.justification: Wind Walk transforms targets into a different physical form (gaseous cloud) with a persistent state bundle (new movement mode, damage resistance, condition immunity, action restrictions) and a reversible toggle (cloud ↔ normal via Magic action + 1-minute transition). No existing SpellMechanics family can represent a creature-form transformation. A new 'transform_form' family is needed with: (a) a bundle of form-state effects, (b) a revert mechanic with transition condition, and (c) a re-enter mechanic.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You and up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range assume gaseous forms for the duration, appearing as wisps of cloud. [...] The only actions a target can take in this form are the Dash action or a Magic action to begin reverting to its normal form. Reverting takes 1 minute, during which the target has the Stunned condition. Until the spell ends, the target can revert to cloud form, which also requires a Magic action followed by a 1-minute transformation.

proposed_widenings.name: stunned in Condition type
proposed_widenings.justification: Condition is currently restricted to 'prone'. Wind Walk inflicts Stunned during the revert-to-normal transition, requiring 'stunned' to be added to the Condition union.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Reverting takes 1 minute, during which the target has the Stunned condition.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_immunity (condition or damage type)
proposed_widenings.justification: Wind Walk grants immunity to the Prone condition in cloud form. The v4 atom inventory has 'grant_resistance' but no 'grant_immunity'. Immunity is a mechanically distinct concept (immune = no effect, resistant = half damage) and cannot be honestly expressed as resistance.
proposed_widenings.evidence: it has Immunity to the Prone condition

proposed_widenings.name: allow_only variant for ActionRestriction
proposed_widenings.justification: The current ActionRestriction type supports 'exclude' (denylist). Cloud form restricts targets to only Dash and Magic — an allowlist. A new variant { kind: 'allow_only', actions: ReadonlyArray<StandardActionKind> } is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The only actions a target can take in this form are the Dash action or a Magic action to begin reverting to its normal form.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_speed / grant_fly_speed as SpellEffect variant
proposed_widenings.justification: Wind Walk grants a Fly Speed of 300 feet with hover. The v4 atoms 'modify_speed' and 'grant_hover' exist in the taxonomy but are not available as variants of Effect or any ongoing spell operation type. They would need to be added to the effect vocabulary for spells.
proposed_widenings.evidence: a target has a Fly Speed of 300 feet and can hover

proposed_widenings.name: self_plus_choose_up_to attachment mode
proposed_widenings.justification: Wind Walk targets the caster plus up to 10 willing others. No current Attachment kind combines self-inclusion with a choose_up_to selection. The closest is { kind: 'target', selection: { mode: 'choose_up_to', count: ... } } which excludes the caster, or { kind: 'self' } which excludes others.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You and up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range assume gaseous forms

notes: The primary blocker is structural: Wind Walk requires a form-transformation family that does not exist in the surface. The existing families (ongoing_effect, activation, triggered_reaction, anchored_trigger) cannot express a reversible creature-form change with a bundled state (fly speed, immunity, resistance, action constraints) and a 1-minute transition cost guarded by a condition (Stunned). Secondary gaps include: missing 'stunned' in Condition, missing grant_immunity atom, missing allowlist ActionRestriction variant, and missing fly-speed/hover spell effects. The safe-descent fallback clause (60 ft/round descent for 1 minute if airborne on spell end) is also not expressible and may classify as dm_agenda or require a new 'on_end_condition' shape. No dhall, json, or trace files produced.
